metadata.description: Small Claude Code plugins that enforce rather than advise: a guard that stops shell commands from reading or printing secrets, and plans whose stages close only on a passing command.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Bash and PowerShell commands that read secret files or print credentials, Docker commands that leak them, and commits that stage them.

plugins.name: proof-plans
plugins.description: A per-project plan whose stages close only when a named command exits green; the plan is printed back at every session start.
